scope: Original source audit for external-pin-only classic VC1/VC2 polling. No source or driver changes, tests, firmware runs or external publication performed. GPIO route extraction excluded. All statements refer to pinned local artifacts, not a claim of live latest-version discovery.

clock_gate.readback_expectation: No gate ACK or gate-specific post-enable delay/readback requirement found in the cited gate/VC sections. A volatile gate readback can defensively confirm the bit; it does not establish analog READY.

cr1.polling_baseline: All writable CR1 fields zero: interrupts/filter/blank/ATIM connections disabled; reserved bits remain reset values. F002 CR1[31:8] reserved.

fltv.meaning: digital-filter output level, downstream of polarity/window path; not a separate raw analog comparator bit

startup.requirement: After EN=1 wait for SR.READY=1 before using comparator. READY describes startup stability, not the absence of input propagation delay.

manual_records.external_only_consequence: Use only audited external GPIO input encodings. No ADC/BGR/temperature/divider enable or writes are needed for these sources. DIV is shared and must remain untouched. Gate/reset are also shared; enable gate by protected read-modify-write, never reset either instance as part of individual construction/drop, and leave gate enabled.

common_characterization.scope: Values checked individually in all ten family comparator tables. Not generalized from another family.

threshold_temperature_coefficient.conditions: VDD=3.3 V, V-=(n/64)*Vref; -40<TA<+105 C on F030/A030/F020/F002/F003 and -40<TA<+85 C on L031/R031/W031/L052/L083. This divided-reference condition is outside external-pin-only operation; do not promise it for arbitrary external inputs.

important_qualifications: All nine manuals response prose says 200 ns..20 us, while all ten newer selected datasheets list ultra-low startup and propagation typical and characterized max as 10 us. Retain discrepancy explicitly; API should use named modes rather than exact delay guarantees and await READY.
Register names and readbacks are software-visible evidence only. No on-silicon comparator timing, noise, startup, deep-sleep, or electrical validation was performed.
Read SR without writing it. Reading FLTV does not clear INTF. Polling can leave peripheral IE disabled and never touch NVIC.

The shared APBEN2 bit controls configuration access to both comparators. A gate readback is not a required analog settling delay. Individual drop should disable only that instance EN and leave shared gate, reset and DIV untouched.
Each input must stay between ground and its stated analog supply. Generic GPIO input/stress tolerances (such as -0.3 V or rail+0.3 V) do not expand the comparator functional input range.

Positive input greater than negative corresponds to high when POL=0 and WINDOW=0, after applicable hysteresis and response delay. Equality/near-threshold behavior is not guaranteed because offset and noise remain, even with HYS=0.
Hysteresis names denote approximate/typical settings only. Do not turn schematic +/- labels into a guaranteed full-width or half-width tolerance specification.
F002 has CR1[31:8] reserved, whereas the other audited manuals have ATIM/blanking fields. Zero is a safe polling baseline for both; no common driver should configure absent fields.

The legacy root-level CW32F020_DataSheet_CN_V1.3.pdf is actually printed Rev 1.2 and superseded; this audit uses current-datasheets/CW32F020_DataSheet_CN_V1.3.pdf, printed Rev 1.3, SHA256 1e330d800f10114c654b97cbd45b64d56a99c3cb39138d4ef20de3c12968dab0.
unresolved: Manual 200 ns..20 us response prose conflicts with newer datasheet ultra-low 10 us typical/characterized maximum; preserved without resolving.
No explicit gate-specific readback or post-enable delay requirement found in cited clock/VC sections; an optional software readback is not an analog settling guarantee.
No independent audit of GPIO routes in this assignment.
No claim that READY deassertion timing on disable/reconfiguration was established.
